assessments.reasoning: OSI CMS record 546 matches the claimed digest and renders “Licensed under the Non-Profit Open Software License version 3.0” adjacent to the copyright notice. Section 17 explicitly names the amended edition and explains how it differs from ordinary OSL.

The Index’s admission table distinguishes a license with an identifiable grant and edition from an exception to a base license. OSI’s complete Non-Profit publication meets the license criterion for the proposed local record.

challenge.method: Tested whether Non-Profit was merely a descriptive label on ordinary OSL 3.0 or a standalone exception. Compared the opening notice, section 1(c) and section 17 with ordinary OSL.
challenge.results: Section 17 names the amended license, specifies a licensor declaration in 17(a), conditions redistribution in 17(d) and requires distinctive notices in 17(e). These provisions and the complete grant resolve the instrument identity without determining eligibility for any work.

limitations: Active describes intended Index treatment. Eligibility to use or redistribute under this edition depends on work-specific facts and the conditions in section 17. The CMS approval date, minutes link and false approval flag do not independently resolve board history.
reasoning: OSI publishes the Non-Profit Open Software License 3.0 as a complete, separately named license. Its grant, distinctive notice and section 17 support its own active local reference.
